[IDSP.13.3] **Purpose.** The compiler wraps the value of every `cache` action in
`FN_JSON_VALUE` (RLOW.7.4), whatever the expression, literal or runtime
([LSTO.4.2.1]). The cache wire is JSON text ([IDSP.7]), and this builtin
produces it. A literal takes the same path as any other value, so there is one
encoding to keep right.
